correctness.rationale: The quotient F5[t]/(t^2-2) is a 25-element field. The provided checker exhaustively enumerates each 3-subset (2300) and 4-subset (12650), independently cross-checks direct traces and bitset trace fibers, checks 100 explicit missing triples and all group orbit closures. Translation incidence gives exact coefficients, and 2^5>25 rules out larger supports. The first-order comparison enumerates all admissible smaller Paley graph orders. This proves the finite claim without extrapolating samples.

value.rationale: This is the first Paley graph of permissible order saturating VC dimension four, at the first non-prime-square transition beyond q=17; it gives an exact complete shattering polynomial, a geometrically interpretable classification of all exceptional triples and the eight symmetry orbits of all maximal shattered supports. These are motivated natural invariants for finite-field learning and pseudorandom-graph testing, beyond a generic theorem of computational decidability.
